assessment_effects.baseline_state: Comfort Systems USA presents an exceptional balance sheet ($1.80B net cash) and high capital returns (>28% ROIC), supported by multi-year modular HVAC backlogs for hyperscale data center construction. However, the frozen reference market price of $1439.07 embeds a demanding 30.07% 5-year revenue CAGR at elevated 15.0% operating margins. Retained on watch: await market pullback toward mid-cycle base valuation range ($1,050 - $1,100) or evidence of margin persistence.
assessment_effects.draft_state: Net cash buffer expanded from $1800.7M to $2108.5M. TTM revenue grew from $11.23B to $12.54B. Trailing 12-month margin was 16.70%. Solved 5-year revenue CAGR eased from 30.07% to 26.76%. Market reference price ($1439.07) remains above base intrinsic value ($1215.00). Reported standalone quarterly operating margin (16.58%) did not breach the approved 13.0% invalidation floor, while backlog book-to-bill evidence remains unresolved via Form 10-Q. Core decisive thesis is conditionally maintained pending Product Owner review.
assessment_effects.notes: Quarterly margin condition satisfied, but complete multi-condition thesis maintenance requires owner judgment due to unresolved backlog evidence.
